About

FRAME 024 / 001s

By day I work as a data analyst. By instinct I'm a sculptor — characters and creatures have been my constant for years, from paid commissions to personal studies. Modeling, retopology and texturing are the part of the pipeline I know cold.

Right now I'm adding a new discipline to that foundation: I'm training in character animation at AnimSchool, learning to give the characters I already know how to build a performance — timing, weight, acting.

The long game is directing my own stories: writing a script, designing the cast, and animating it myself, start to finish.
